evidence:
Independently read the actual frozen XLSX with openpyxl: Quality Checks!A51:D51 defines check 50 as "The directory is the closed list ? no scratch, build residue, committed caches, or backups, and all required files present." Also read Deterministic Checks!A21:C21 (check-no-stray-files.py), A25:C25 (check-required-files.py), and Internal Quality Checks!A51:F51 as interpretation only. Applied frozen references/quality-checks.md:200-202, references/staged-task-contract.md:Closed file list, references/deterministic-checks.md:31-38, and SKILL.md:Known false positives. This is an independent manual/source inventory review with local read-only checks, not a private portal checker execution.

Enumerated the entire frozen tree using both Force/Recurse and pathlib, including hidden files/directories. Found 50 regular nonempty files: 2 at root, 8 in environment, 23 in solution, and 17 in tests. All required files and all five judge/prompt pairs exist; six operating notes satisfy environment/instructions/<note>.md. No extra tests entries, retired reward.toml, NOTES.md/SOLUTION.md/.env, node_modules, __pycache__, .git, live database/WAL/SHM, backup/temp files, QC workbooks, archives, saved runs, or OS/editor junk are present. No symlinks or junctions were observed. Full file inventory is recorded below. There is one empty source-only directory, environment/assets/artifacts; it contains no files and is not an archive member. This has no shipped-file impact and is recorded as a nonblocking observation.

Read every frozen file to compute SHA256 and independently compared the complete path/hash map with qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/manifest.json:inputs.task: exact equality, 50/50. Independently read every ZIP member in candidate/colderwater-playground-devtools.zip and compared its relative path and SHA256 against the frozen source: exact equality, 50/50, no extras, missing files, duplicate entries, mismatched bytes, directory entries or symlinks. The actual ZIP SHA256 is 9f63a6bde530883634502471f80c707e8f2362c6e612a080bade7d731255aa07. This measured comparison, rather than the candidate manifest's boolean fields, establishes packaged inventory parity.

Classified the potentially suspicious application files by their actual role. solution/solve.sh:26 copies the reference app to /app. solution/app/server.js:100-102 serves starters and public/index.html. public/index.html:1-2 directly references the packaged /assets/index-VduTT3aN.js and /assets/index-C_1hOHr1.css; these generated assets are required runnable application delivery, not abandoned build residue. vite.config.mjs:2-3 maps static to public, explaining the source and installed runner.html copies; src/runtime.ts:185 requests /runner.html. src/app.tsx:1-3 imports vendor.js, runtime and style.css, and :56 fetches starter files. package.json:scripts, root app/index.html and tsconfig.json:13 explain the build inputs. starters/README.md and running-code.md are documentation within the served golden application tree, not root author/QC notes. All are inside the contract's solution/app/** allowance. The provided seed_data.json is a task-specific asset explicitly allowed by the staged contract; the skill also says any stray-file checker complaint about it must be a Note, never a blocker. coverage.json is absent.

Executed in-memory inventory controls without modifying source: actual inventory produced missing=[], unexpected=[], residue=[]; a conforming inventory plus profile-exempt coverage.json also produced empty error lists; adding solution/app/app.db and solution/app/server.js.bak was detected as residue even within app/**; adding tests/debug-output.json was detected as unexpected; removing tests/tools/restart_mcp.py was detected as missing. These controls support the bounded manual classification; they do not claim execution of the unavailable private checkers or any full judge/Oracle/model run.

counterexample: False-fail witness: rejecting every generated asset would reject this conforming golden app, whose public/index.html actually imports the packaged generated JS/CSS and whose server serves public/. The staged app/** allowance covers these runtime files. Rejecting seed_data.json or an in-memory coverage.json addition also contradicts the explicit profile exception. False-pass witness: a broad app/** allowlist alone would accept an app.db or server.js.bak; the in-memory negative inventory detected both. It also caught an extra tests/debug-output.json and a missing restart_mcp.py. None of those defective inventory variants exists in the frozen task or ZIP.
